capture.context: Polls active application, window title, and a privacy-reduced browser URL.
capture.frames: Screenshots are captured only after an explicit local capture action.
capture.computer_actions: OpenRappter ComputerUse actions are recorded while a session is active, but typed text is never persisted.

analysis.approval: Approval requires a short-lived, single-use token issued by an interactive local CLI or a native Electron main-process confirmation.
analysis.modelEnhancement: Sending the privacy-safe textual event summary to Copilot is optional and requires a separate local consent token. Raw frames are never sent.

artifacts.rule: Artifacts are generated only from an approved analysis and are rejected if privacy scanning changes their content.

privacy.narration: Optional microphone audio is transcribed on-device with Whisper Small q8; the cached model is approximately 252 MB.
